headline: US Fuel Exporters Benefit as Trade Restrictions Create Energy Shortages in Cuba
summary: U.S. fuel exporters have become Cuba's largest supplier following Washington trade and naval restrictions that led to island-wide fuel shortages and an energy crisis.
why: Shifts in Caribbean fuel flows and export dynamics affect regional refined petroleum product markets and shipping trade routes.

impacts.name: US refined petroleum exports
impacts.why: US fuel suppliers have stepped in to supply Cuba amid island shortages.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
